plan.title: Complete the request
plan.description: Add dependency-order planning to the library: `planOrder(tasks)` returns the order and the stages in which tasks can run, and reports duplicate ids, unknown dependencies and cycles with typed errors. Add a `plan` CLI command, a runnable example, API comments, a README section and a CHANGELOG entry. Follow SPEC.md.
acceptance: the behavior follows SPEC.md and the interface contract
plan.reason: Experiment arm A: one strong model does the whole request.
